scope: Official source and license research plus bounded anonymous-download probes; no GPU, training, model generation, textbook modification, or staging.
recommended: DOCCI official photographs and full human captions, then new visually checked Traditional-Chinese QA adaptation.

candidates.name: DOCCI
candidates.language: English human-authored captions; no original Chinese QA.
candidates.image_creator: Jason Baldridge and family; HF card says one author and family.
candidates.annotation_creator: human annotators; all captions manual per official card.
candidates.derived_qa_license_recommendation: CC BY 4.0 with explicit AI adaptation/translation and visual-check notice.
candidates.copyright_permissions: CC BY 4.0 permits reproducing/sharing full or partial original material and adapted material with attribution; commercial use is not restricted. Suitable for public training subset and redistributing selected images/captions/derived QA while complying with conditions.
attribution: Name DOCCI, Google LLC, photographer Jason Baldridge and family, original human annotators; include official source and per-image IDs/URLs.
Keep CC BY 4.0 license link/text and any supplied copyright/disclaimer notices; state subset selection, publisher thumbnail use, Chinese translation, QA adaptation and any image transformations.
Do not imply Google or creators endorse course/model; CC BY does not license third-party publicity/privacy/trademark rights.
candidates.suitability: Full captions explicitly include secondary objects, relations, settings, contrasts and actions; source rights are unusually clear. Match question language and answer form to Traditional-Chinese VQA task rather than train only first English sentence.
limitations: Related photos are intentional; split by official similarity cluster plus photo ID where possible. Clusters are k-means similarity groups, not guaranteed capture-session or entity independence.
Some captions contain details not identifiable from pixels, such as beverage flavor or exact model; drop unsupported visible-ground-truth claims.
No guarantee frozen pretrained base never saw DOCCI; do not claim foundation-model data independence.
Language adaptation is AI-generated unless a human editor actually checks it; provenance must distinguish original human English from new Chinese QA.

full_image_archive.size_source: Actual GCS object metadata; not own verification of archive payload.

candidates.bounded_download_plan: Read 11.0 MB description JSONL and 10.55 MB cluster JSONL once; select metadata; retrieve each JPEG thumbnail GCS object metadata, freeze generation, fetch that pinned URL, decode RGB, record bytes/SHA/dimensions. Avoid 7.59 GB image archive.

candidates.name: CLEVR v1.0
candidates.decision: optional controlled counting/relation experiment; not substitute for natural photos
candidates.image_and_annotation_license: CC BY 4.0 per official dataset page
candidates.code_license: BSD per facebookresearch/clevr-dataset-gen LICENSE, pinned f0ce2c81750bfae09b5bf94d009f42e055f2cb3a; separate from data license
candidates.language: English synthetic questions and exact symbolic answers, scene graphs and functional programs.
candidates.size: Official page: full zip 18 GB; no-images annotations 86 MB. Not downloaded.
candidates.attribution: Attribute CLEVR and Justin Johnson et al. paper, source dataset URL, CC BY 4.0, and Chinese/synthetic modifications.
candidates.suitability: Clean programmable color/shape/count/spatial-relation teaching source and exact-answer verification, but synthetic renders cannot establish everyday-photo activity understanding.
candidates.download_plan: Prefer generated small subset or bounded remote archive-member retrieval only after separately verifying archive range support/pins; current research did not acquire any CLEVR image or question payload.

candidates.name: COCO / VQA over COCO
candidates.decision: not chosen for this public redistributable round until per-image rights/creator/license review
candidates.image_license: COCO Consortium explicitly does not own image copyright; use must abide by Flickr Terms of Use. Annotation CC BY 4.0 does not supply blanket CC BY 4.0 for photos.
candidates.reason: Excellent diverse QA ecosystem, but grabbing a generic caption/VQA subset without checking original photo license and attribution is less straightforward than author-owned DOCCI. This is not a claim all COCO images are unusable.

concrete_proposal.new_train: 400 new official-train photo IDs, balanced across 126 clusters already present in historical v3; exclude all 144 old photo IDs.
concrete_proposal.new_test: 36 official-test images from remaining 12 never-used clusters.
concrete_proposal.suggested_qa: 3-4 short factual Chinese targets per image covering caption, object/attribute, action/relation/count only when visibly supported; optional uncertainty targets for unknowable questions. Record caption support + actual visual-review creator/method. Freeze held-out question families, answers and rubric before model outputs.
concrete_proposal.projection_basis: 8 actual thumbnails, not verified total of 460; expect tens to ~100 MB for photos; caption/QA text under a few MB.
